title: Performance Boost! Grok 4.6 Officially Released, Standing Shoulder to Shoulder with GPT-5.6 Sol

content_html:
Recently, SpaceX AI officially launched its upgraded flagship artificial intelligence model, Grok4.6. This model focuses on handling complex, long-term agent tasks and has demonstrated strong performance that matches or even exceeds the leading OpenAI model GPT-5.6Sol in multiple core benchmark tests.

Looking back at its technological evolution, SpaceX AI had previously collaborated with Cursor to launch Grok4.5 in July, which was trained using the computing power of tens of thousands of NVIDIA GB300 GPUs. Building on this foundation, Grok4.6 achieved a further breakthrough. Its training process focused on comprehensive optimization for long-term complex tasks, extensively utilizing model-generated data that includes reasoning capabilities, advanced technical concepts, and high-quality engineering code. Additionally, the model underwent extensive agent-based reinforcement learning training, covering knowledge work, general programming, and multiple specialized domain environments, enabling it to produce higher-quality initial results when building visual and interactive applications.

In the comprehensive index of nine popular AI benchmark tests by the authoritative evaluation organization Artificial Analysis, Grok4.6's overall score has caught up with GPT-5.6Sol, currently trailing only Claude Opus5 and Fable5Max. Specifically, in the GDPval-AA v2 test evaluating logic and knowledge level, Grok4.6 achieved an Elo score of 1753; and in the private benchmark test AA-Briefcase assessing long-term knowledge work agent tasks, its Elo score reached 1577 points. Both key performances are second only to Claude Opus5.

While delivering significant performance improvements, Grok4.6 continues to maintain a highly competitive operating speed and pricing structure. The model can run at 80 TPS, with the base version's input and output prices being $2 and $6 per million tokens, respectively. The high-speed variant version is $4 and $12 per million tokens. Currently, Cursor and Grok Build users can start using it directly, and developers can also conveniently access it through the API.

content_html_zh:
近日，SpaceX AI正式推出升级版旗舰人工智能模型Grok4.6。 该模型专注于处理复杂、长期的智能体任务，在多核基准测试中表现出了与领先的 OpenAI 模型 GPT-5.6Sol 相匹配甚至超过的强大性能。

回顾其技术演变，SpaceX AI 此前曾与 Cursor 合作于 7 月推出了 Grok4.5，该系统使用数万个 NVIDIA GB300 GPU 的计算能力进行训练。 在此基础上，Grok4.6取得了进一步的突破。 其训练过程侧重于对长期复杂任务的全面优化，广泛利用模型生成的数据，包括推理能力、先进的技术概念和高质量的工程代码。 此外，该模型还接受了广泛的基于代理的强化学习训练，涵盖知识工作、通用编程和多个专业领域环境，使其在构建视觉和交互式应用程序时能够产生更高质量的初始结果。

在权威评测机构Artificial Analysis对九个热门AI基准测试的综合指数中，Grok4.6的总体得分已经赶上GPT-5.6Sol，目前仅落后于Claude Opus5和Fable5Max。 具体来说，在评估逻辑和知识水平的GDPval-AA v2测试中，Grok4.6取得了1753分的Elo分数；而在评估长期知识工作代理任务的私人基准测试AA-Briefcase中，其Elo分数达到了1577分。 两项关键性能均仅次于Claude Opus5。

在提供显着性能改进的同时，Grok4.6 继续保持极具竞争力的运行速度和定价结构。 该模型可以以 80 TPS 的速度运行，基础版本的输入和输出价格分别为每百万代币 2 美元和 6 美元。 高速变体版本的价格为每百万代币 4 美元和 12 美元。 目前，Cursor和Grok Build用户可以直接开始使用，开发者也可以通过API方便地访问它。
